problem: LIFT post-motion hold lacks adapter abnormal-exit boundary: first observer RuntimeError leaves retained target active, no stop and stale SUCCEEDED.

root_cause: lift catches only MotionGuardViolation inside per-step loop; step, contacts and monitor_hold ordinary failures have no whole-hold result/stop boundary.
monitor_hold holds on BaseException and rethrows; adapter must translate ordinary exceptions and preserve cancellation semantics.
move_tcp sets motion SUCCEEDED before 0.5-second hold; failed hold must replace session terminal reason.
Observer can throw after backend physics count increments but before held_steps increment; use backend delta for failure accounting.

scope.artifacts: New round evidence/report and stage-summary entry only; historical bytes frozen

contract.ordinary_exception: After successful movement, catch Exception across full hold context, guards/steps/contacts/samples and final measurement. Direct backend.emergency_stop() before result avoids safe_stop pre-snapshot. Return success=false, action_type=LIFT, error_code=LIFT_HOLD_FAILED; details.failure_phase=LIFT_HOLD, reason=str(original), exception_type=type(original).__name__. build_action_result already copies details into error.details.
contract.base_exception: For non-Exception BaseException, stop then re-raise same original object. No ordinary result conversion.
contract.guard: Catch MotionGuardViolation first; preserve code/reason and existing hold_current_joints stop policy, including GRASP_LOST and CLEARANCE_PATH_VIOLATION.
contract.session: Failed hold terminal_reason is type(error).__name__ + colon + str(error); refresh result visual_servo summary from current session. Never overwrite original reason with generic code.
contract.accounting: Before hold record hold_start_steps; physics_steps = prior action physics_steps + backend.total_physics_steps - hold_start_steps. Stop advances zero physics steps.
contract.stop_precondition: Existing backend stop and snapshot remain operational. Cleanup failure must not be reported as successful stop or erase original exception context; a new cleanup/backend root cause requires next plan, not generic recovery work here.
